description: This file contains extension methods for configuring Redis-based reminder storage in Orleans silo builders and service collections. It provides methods to add Redis reminder services and configure related options.

classes.name: SiloBuilderReminderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to add Redis reminder storage to Orleans silo builders and service collections.
